lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a structured multi-tiered horizontal grid posterior to the gill slits. Centroids follow a repeating linear sequence across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a well-defined lattice of anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing immediately ventral to the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of smaller, more concentrated high-luminance spots compared to the larger, grid-aligned blobs on the primary lateral flank.
